title: "Yesterday's Results"
date: today
params:
  recap_date: null
format:
  html:
    self-contained: true
    embed-resources: true
    theme: cosmo
    toc: false
    smooth-scroll: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r setup}
#| output: false
if (basename(getwd()) == "09_reporting") setwd("..")

library(dplyr)
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(readr)

source("09_reporting/_recap_helpers.R")

recap_date <- if (!is.null(params$recap_date)) as.Date(params$recap_date) else Sys.Date() - 1
recap_label <- format(recap_date, "%A, %B %d, %Y")
```

```{r header}
#| output: asis
cat(sprintf("# Yesterday's Results — %s\n\n", recap_label))
```
